name: Bank statement files over SFTP
summary: Reads a bank's statement files (MT940, camt.053 or OFX) from the SFTP folder the bank delivers to, into Banking, read-only: each money account named by a statement is fed hourly in file-name order. It never writes to, renames or deletes in the folder.

capabilities.trigger_rule: The sync schedule: the tick's hourly bank.sync.

address.title: SFTP server
address.description: The bank's SFTP host and port, such as sftp.bank.example:22.

user.title: User name
user.description: The user the bank gave this connection.

folder.title: Folder
folder.description: The folder the bank leaves statement files in, such as /outbox.

host_key_sha256.title: Host key fingerprint
host_key_sha256.description: The server's host key as the bank gives it, SHA256:… (as ssh-keygen -l prints it). A server with any other key is refused.

intraday_folder.title: Intraday reports folder (optional)
intraday_folder.description: The folder the bank leaves its MT942 intraday reports in, if it has one. Each credit in them becomes a pending "likely paid" signal, never a statement line; the daily statement closes it.

format.title: File format
format.description: The format of the files the bank delivers.

secrets.name: private_key
secrets.title: Private key
secrets.description: The private key (OpenSSH or PEM, without a passphrase) whose public half the bank authorised for this user.

provider_scopes: SFTP: read the statement folder (list and read; no write)
health_check: Each feed's last sync and why it stopped: a refused key, a changed host key, an unreadable or PGP-wrapped file.
test_action: Connects, lists the folder's files and the accounts their statements name, and reports whether the bank accepted the key and the host key matched.
local_substitute: A directory on this machine in local mode (the filedrop-local connector), and an in-process SFTP server in tests. Against a real bank it is [live-verify].
